verdict.rationale: Tavily offers limited batching and async options: Extract accepts up to 20 URLs per request with per-URL failure reporting, and Research runs as an async task whose status and results are retrieved by request ID. However, nothing in the evidence shows a batch or async job API for high-volume search queries. Throughput is bounded by per-minute rate limits (1,000 RPM in production), with 429/retry-after handling. Missing for 10: batch submission of multiple search queries, a general async job queue for high-volume query workloads, documented bulk or job pricing and limits beyond RPM.
